name: Minga London

prices.note: 33 of 43 jeans at regular price (10 with compare_at above price excluded; 3 carry a 'sale' tag with no markdown and count as regular per enrich.md); baggy, straight, flared and bootcut; waists 24–38

notes: The US store (us.mingalondon.com) prices in USD; the main site prices in GBP. The women's shop-all showed $79–$160, but that includes accessories, so it isn't stored.
About: 'We create for those who embrace their weirdness!'; an independent brand born in East London in 2014; HQ not stated.
Shipping: the help article names UK, USA and EU orders (customs section) but doesn't list destinations. The US free-shipping threshold is blank in the page text, so it is null.
The size range comes from product sizes on the men's page (S–XXXL, XS–XL). WebSearch suggests the size guide runs XS–XXXL (UK 24–26), but it wasn't fetched, so has_plus is null.
2026-10-29: old streetwear row dropped (style, not product type); jeans row added. Regular price = no variant with compare_at_price above price and no sale/markdown tag; sale items excluded.
